title: Pip the Little Glow Ghost
summary: A friendly little ghost who glows like a pumpkin lantern wants to join the Harvest Moon Party, and when the lanterns blow out, his kind glow shows everyone that looking different is a wonderful thing.
character: Pip, a small round friendly ghost made of soft cream-white tissue paper, shaped like a gumdrop with a wavy wiggly tail instead of feet, two stubby little arms, big round shiny black eyes, rosy pink cheeks, a tiny happy smile, a little orange knitted scarf, and a gentle warm golden-orange glow around his edges

cover.scene: Pip floats happily above a moonlit pumpkin patch on a hill, glowing warm pumpkin-orange, surrounded by carved smiling pumpkin lanterns, curly vines, autumn leaves, a big full moon and stars, a little red barn on the hilltop

pages.text: At the very top of Pumpkin Hill, in a cozy old red barn, lived a little ghost named Pip. Pip was soft and round, with a wiggly tail instead of feet, and he loved to float through the hay, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh. Best of all, when the sky grew dark, Pip glowed a warm, toasty orange, just like a pumpkin lantern on a chilly autumn night.
pages.scene: Pip floats happily inside a cozy old red barn full of hay bales at dusk, glowing warmly; a little round window shows an orange sunset and a hill covered in pumpkins

pages.text: Every fall, the animals of Pumpkin Hill held a Harvest Moon Party down in the pumpkin patch. There were warm apple muffins, twinkly pumpkin lanterns, and lots and lots of happy dancing under the big, round moon. Pip pressed his face against the barn window and watched the fun. More than anything in the whole wide world, he wanted to join the party too.
pages.scene: Pip peeks wistfully out of the round barn window at night, looking down the hill at a pumpkin patch party with glowing carved smiling pumpkin lanterns, squirrels and bunnies dancing, a table of apple muffins, and a big full moon

pages.text: So Pip took a brave breath, floated down the hill, and gave everyone his very best hello. But a ghost's hello comes out a little bit funny. "Boooo!" The bunnies hopped, the squirrels jumped, and Little Owl tumbled right off her branch with a surprised "Whoo-oops!" Nobody was hurt, but everybody stared at Pip with big, round eyes.
pages.scene: Pip waves hello with a big friendly smile at the edge of the pumpkin patch; silly startled reaction: two bunnies hopping up in the air, ONE squirrel jumping, and Little Owl, a small round brown owl with big amber eyes and a tiny green knitted hat tumbling comically off a tree branch; funny, not scary

pages.text: "Oh, dear," sighed Pip, and his glow grew small and dim, like a candle almost ready for bed. He hid behind a big pumpkin and rested his chin in his hands. "They think I'm spooky, just because I look different," he whispered. "Maybe if I look like everybody else, they will let me come to the party."
pages.scene: Pip sits alone behind a big pumpkin, looking a little sad, his glow dim and soft, chin in his little hands; the party lanterns twinkle in the background

pages.text: First, Pip found a pair of long, floppy bunny ears and wore them proudly on his head. But the ears slid down, flip, flop, right over his eyes, and Pip couldn't see a single thing! Bonk! He bumped straight into a pumpkin and spun around and around like a wobbly top. "Whoa, whoa, whoa!" he giggled, feeling very dizzy indeed.
pages.scene: Pip wearing a pair of long floppy pretend bunny ears made of paper that have slid down over his eyes, bumping comically into a big orange pumpkin and spinning; silly and funny

pages.text: Next, Pip tied on a big, bushy squirrel tail and tried to swish it just like the squirrels did. But the fluffy fur tickled his nose, tickle, tickle, tickle. "Ah... ah... ah-CHOO!" The tail shot off like a rocket and landed, plop, right on top of the scarecrow's hat. Pip laughed, but deep down inside, he still felt a little bit lonely.
pages.scene: Pip mid-sneeze with a funny face, a pretend bushy squirrel tail flying off him through the air toward a friendly smiling scarecrow in the pumpkin patch; silly and funny

pages.text: Pip floated over to the biggest pumpkin in the patch and sat down, feeling small and quiet. Just then, a chilly wind came whooshing across the hill, swirling the crunchy leaves around and around. Puff, puff, puff! One by one, every single pumpkin lantern blinked out, and the whole Harvest Moon Party went dark.
pages.scene: a gust of wind swirls autumn leaves across the pumpkin patch at night; the carved pumpkin lanterns have just gone out with little curls of smoke; Pip sits on a big pumpkin looking up in surprise; only moonlight and Pip's soft glow

pages.text: "Mama? Where are you?" squeaked a tiny voice in the darkness. It was Baby Bunny, and she couldn't find her mama anywhere. Pip didn't wait one single second. He took a great big breath and glowed brighter, and brighter, and brighter, until he was as warm and golden as a pumpkin full of sunshine.
pages.scene: Baby Bunny, a tiny fluffy light-gray baby bunny with a white tummy, long floppy ears and a little pink bow on one ear stands in the dark pumpkin patch looking up hopefully; Pip floats beside her glowing very brightly with warm pumpkin-orange light that fills the scene and lights up the pumpkins and vines

pages.text: "Follow my glow!" Pip whispered gently. He floated slowly over the twisty vines, lighting up the path like a little lantern, so nobody would trip or tumble. Baby Bunny hopped right behind him, hop, hop, hop, all the way to the apple cart. And there was Mama Bunny, with her arms open wide. Snuggle, snuggle, snuggle!
pages.scene: Pip glowing and lighting a winding path through the pumpkin vines; Baby Bunny, a tiny fluffy light-gray baby bunny with a white tummy, long floppy ears and a little pink bow on one ear hops happily toward Mama Bunny, a bigger light-gray mother rabbit wearing a blue apron who kneels by a wooden apple cart with open arms for a big hug

pages.text: All the animals gathered around Pip with wide, shining eyes. "We're sorry," said Little Owl kindly. "We thought you were spooky because you looked different from us. But you are kind and brave, and your glow is the most beautiful light on the whole hill." Pip's cheeks turned as pink as a strawberry, and his heart felt warm and full.
pages.scene: the animals gather in a friendly circle around Pip in the pumpkin patch: Little Owl, a small round brown owl with big amber eyes and a tiny green knitted hat speaking kindly, Baby Bunny, a tiny fluffy light-gray baby bunny with a white tummy, long floppy ears and a little pink bow on one ear and Mama Bunny, a bigger light-gray mother rabbit wearing a blue apron, two squirrels and a hedgehog, all smiling warmly; Pip blushing with rosy cheeks, glowing happily

pages.text: So the party began all over again, with Pip glowing happily right in the middle of everyone. They danced in a great big circle, they giggled and twirled, and they munched warm apple muffins until their tummies were full. And from that night on, "Boooo!" was the friendliest, happiest party cheer on all of Pumpkin Hill.
pages.scene: joyful party in the pumpkin patch at night: Pip glowing in the center while Little Owl, a small round brown owl with big amber eyes and a tiny green knitted hat, Baby Bunny, a tiny fluffy light-gray baby bunny with a white tummy, long floppy ears and a little pink bow on one ear, Mama Bunny, a bigger light-gray mother rabbit wearing a blue apron and two squirrels dance in a circle around him, a table of apple muffins, the pumpkin lanterns relit, bunting of paper leaves

pages.text: When the moon was high, the sleepy animals curled up together in the soft, warm hay of the old red barn. Pip glowed low and gentle, like a cozy night-light, so nobody felt afraid of the dark. "Goodnight, my friends," he whispered with a yawn. And everyone whispered back, soft and sleepy, "Goodnight, Pip."
pages.scene: inside the cozy red barn at night: Baby Bunny, a tiny fluffy light-gray baby bunny with a white tummy, long floppy ears and a little pink bow on one ear and Mama Bunny, a bigger light-gray mother rabbit wearing a blue apron, Little Owl, a small round brown owl with big amber eyes and a tiny green knitted hat and two squirrels are curled up asleep in soft hay; Pip floats gently above them glowing softly like a night-light, eyes sleepy and smiling; moon through the round window; calm bedtime mood
